verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenHands agents run in sandboxed backends (Docker, VMs, Apptainer, managed cloud sandboxes) with Git integrations. Its automations work directly on repositories, for example inspecting failed CI and opening fix PRs, which implies repo checkout and environment setup inside the sandbox. However, no item explicitly says the agent clones the repo, installs dependencies, or configures its own environment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic repo cloning, dependency installation and environment self-configuration, plus hands-on or independent corroboration.
